note: Each chapter quotes exactly one verse, its opening epigraph (block 0); the English quotes no other scripture. Scripture authority is the shipped es corpus (modern Reina-Valera register), per the translation-worker skill — the ebible spa_rv is archaic RV1909 and was not used.

`mined` rows are a verbatim substring of the cited file's rendering of that verse. Where the English epigraph quotes only part of a verse, the Spanish quotes the same part of the corpus wording (Gálatas 5:1 follows the corpus's clause order, «Para libertad nos hizo libres Cristo; estad, pues, firmes»; Marcos 11:24 stops before «y os vendrá», as the English stops before 'and ye shall have them').

`self_rendered` rows are written in RVR1960 register from the translator's knowledge of that text, not pasted from a source: please check them. Lucas 16:10 matches the wording of the shipped article what-makes-a-godly-leader.es, but articles are not a checkable mined source, so it is recorded as self_rendered.
